'''Restricted Band APA 5''' was a transmission frequency that could be picked up by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scanners on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]]. It was known to be a frequency on which [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] would send communications, and when a signal on this band was picked up by an officer loyal to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Marcellin Wessel]], the governor knew that the signal could only be the emergency transmission by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to her friends with the use of a [[Distress beacon/Legends|emergency beacon]].
